method: Six limited meme tone/remix lenses,12exposures each,3per optionposition; rawcounts andallhighestties; no age/gender/ideology/clinical/personalityinferencing; notIDRequivalent.

prompt.en: A friend shares a post about an ordinary day going slightly wrong. Which reply would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 朋友发帖说普通的一天有点不顺，你更愿意怎样回复？

label.en: A short acknowledgement that I recognise that kind of moment.
label.zh: 简单说一句，自己懂这种时刻。

label.en: A small next step that could still make the evening pleasant.
label.zh: 想一个仍能让今晚舒服些的小步骤。

label.en: A dry observation about how neat plans meet messy reality.
label.zh: 淡淡调侃一下完美计划和混乱现实的差别。

label.en: A familiar old reference we have both enjoyed before.
label.zh: 提一个彼此以前都喜欢的老梗。

prompt.en: An online hobby group proposes a fresh start for its weekly activity. What attracts you first?
prompt.zh: 线上兴趣小组想给每周活动换个开头，你首先被什么吸引？

label.en: A modest change we can actually try this week.
label.zh: 这周就能试的一点小改进。

label.en: An honest note about what the change will not magically fix.
label.zh: 坦率说清换开头不会神奇解决什么。

label.en: Keeping the part of the old format that people still enjoy.
label.zh: 保留旧形式里大家仍喜欢的部分。

label.en: Trying a recently invented format just to see what it feels like.
label.zh: 体验一种最近才出现的新形式。

prompt.en: A post promises that one tiny hack will transform every hobby session. What response appeals most?
prompt.zh: 一条帖子声称一个小技巧就能改变每次兴趣练习，你更接近哪种回应？

label.en: An understated reaction to the gap between the promise and real life.
label.zh: 克制地吐槽一下宣传和现实之间的距离。

label.en: An example of the familiar method I still enjoy using.
label.zh: 举一个自己仍喜欢的老办法。

label.en: A quick trial of the new presentation style, without assuming it works.
label.zh: 不先认定有效，快速体验一下新呈现方式。

label.en: Continuing the simple routine that already suits this session.
label.zh: 照这次活动合适的简单流程继续。

prompt.en: You can choose the style of a casual weekend playlist post. What would you favour?
prompt.zh: 周末随手分享歌单，你更喜欢哪种呈现？

label.en: A familiar selection with a story about why I kept it.
label.zh: 熟悉的曲目，再讲讲为什么一直留着。

label.en: A new sharing format I have not played with before.
label.zh: 用一种自己还没试过的新分享形式。

label.en: The regular list format that makes browsing straightforward.
label.zh: 照常列清单，让人容易浏览。

label.en: A line about the ordinary feeling that connected these songs for me.
label.zh: 写一句这些歌共同勾起的普通感受。

prompt.en: A friend introduces a new way to record hobby progress. What interests you most?
prompt.zh: 朋友介绍一种记录兴趣进展的新方式，你最感兴趣的是？

label.en: Exploring its unfamiliar format for one low-stakes entry.
label.zh: 先用不重要的一条记录试试陌生格式。

label.en: Seeing whether it fits the small routine I want to keep.
label.zh: 看看是否适合自己想保留的小流程。

label.en: Finding a way to express the experience, not just the finished item.
label.zh: 找到一种能写出过程感受、不只晒成品的方式。

label.en: Using it to choose a manageable next attempt.
label.zh: 用它安排一次能做到的下一步尝试。

prompt.en: You have a few minutes to contribute to a recurring community thread. Which post would you choose?
prompt.zh: 有几分钟参与固定的社区帖子，你更愿意发什么？

label.en: My usual brief check-in in the familiar thread format.
label.zh: 按常用格式简单报个到。

label.en: A small experience someone else might recognise in their own day.
label.zh: 分享别人也许会有共鸣的小经历。

label.en: One feasible thing I am looking forward to trying.
label.zh: 说一件自己期待尝试、也做得到的小事。

label.en: A wry comment about a minor inconvenience we all met.
label.zh: 对大家碰到的小麻烦来一句冷调调侃。

prompt.en: An imperfect craft attempt is ready to share. What caption feels closest?
prompt.zh: 一件不完美的手工作品可以分享了，你更接近哪种配文？

label.en: Something that names the very ordinary feeling of making it.
label.zh: 写出做它时那种很普通的感受。

label.en: A note about one small part I can build on next time.
label.zh: 记下下次可以接着改好的一小处。

label.en: A restrained joke about the difference between the tutorial and my version.
label.zh: 克制地开个玩笑，比较教程和自己的版本。

label.en: A nod to an older attempt or reference that I still like.
label.zh: 提一提自己仍喜欢的旧作或老参考。

prompt.en: A favourite casual activity is becoming more complicated online. Which response attracts you?
prompt.zh: 喜欢的休闲活动在线上越玩越复杂，你更倾向怎样回应？

label.en: Pick one uncomplicated part I can still enjoy doing.
label.zh: 挑一个不复杂、仍能开心做的小部分。

label.en: Question the idea that every session needs to become an achievement.
label.zh: 质疑一下是否每次都得变成成果。

label.en: Revisit the earlier version that made me like it.
label.zh: 回头玩玩当初让自己喜欢上的版本。

label.en: Try a new lightweight format that changes the experience.
label.zh: 试一种改变体验的轻巧新形式。

prompt.en: You see an unusually polished account of someone’s daily routine. What would you rather share?
prompt.zh: 看到别人把日常流程展示得格外完美，你更想分享什么？

label.en: A dry reminder that ordinary days rarely follow a perfect edit.
label.zh: 冷冷补一句，普通一天很少照完美剪辑来过。

label.en: A well-worn favourite that has stayed enjoyable without an upgrade.
label.zh: 一件没升级、却一直喜欢的老物件或老玩法。

label.en: A playful experiment with the presentation format itself.
label.zh: 拿这种呈现形式本身做个轻松实验。

label.en: An unremarkable piece of my own repeatable routine.
label.zh: 发一点自己可以重复的小日常。

prompt.en: An old game you liked is being discussed again. Which contribution feels most appealing?
prompt.zh: 以前喜欢的老游戏又被讨论起来，你更愿意贡献什么？

label.en: A specific detail I still enjoy from the original experience.
label.zh: 说一个原来体验里至今仍喜欢的细节。

label.en: An unfamiliar way people are now sharing or remixing it.
label.zh: 体验大家现在分享或改编它的新方式。

label.en: A simple account of how it fits my regular downtime.
label.zh: 简单说说它怎样融入平时的休息。

label.en: The feeling of recognising a moment I had almost forgotten.
label.zh: 说说重新认出一个快忘掉的瞬间是什么感觉。

prompt.en: A chat is experimenting with a new kind of weekly prompt. What would you prefer to do?
prompt.zh: 聊天小组在试新的每周话题格式，你更愿意怎么参加？

label.en: Try the format once, even without a polished contribution.
label.zh: 先试一次格式，不追求成品漂亮。

label.en: Use the clear repeatable part that makes joining easy.
label.zh: 用容易重复的清楚步骤来参加。

label.en: Share a response that lets someone say they have felt that too.
label.zh: 写一段别人也能说“我也有过”的回应。

label.en: Suggest one small version that could work next week.
label.zh: 建议一个下周可以落实的小版本。

prompt.en: There is nothing remarkable to post at the end of your hobby week. What suits you best?
prompt.zh: 兴趣活动这一周没什么特别值得发的，你更接近哪种做法？

label.en: Keep the ordinary check-in short and familiar.
label.zh: 照常简短地记录一下。

label.en: Describe one small moment that felt recognisable rather than impressive.
label.zh: 写一个有共鸣、不必惊艳的小瞬间。

label.en: Choose a modest thing to look forward to next week.
label.zh: 选一件下周可以期待的小事。

label.en: Make a restrained joke about the demand to have weekly highlights.
label.zh: 对每周都得有高光这件事轻轻吐槽。

prompt.en: A friend posts a slightly awkward first attempt at a new pastime. What response appeals most?
prompt.zh: 朋友分享新爱好的第一次尝试，有点笨拙，你更愿意怎样回应？

label.en: Recognise the experience without turning it into a big lesson.
label.zh: 承认自己懂这种经历，不急着升华。

label.en: Notice one usable part they could try again if they want.
label.zh: 指出一处想继续时可以再试的小部分。

label.en: Share a dry, friendly observation about how first attempts usually look.
label.zh: 友善而冷调地说说第一次通常就这模样。

label.en: Recall an older example we still enjoy despite its rough edges.
label.zh: 提一件虽粗糙却一直喜欢的旧例子。

prompt.en: A long hobby wish list is starting to feel like homework. What would you prefer?
prompt.zh: 兴趣愿望清单越来越像作业，你更想怎么处理？

label.en: Choose one small enjoyable item and leave the rest undecided.
label.zh: 选一件小而好玩的，其余先不定。

label.en: Point out, with a little irony, that leisure does not need a productivity target.
label.zh: 略带讽刺地提醒，休闲也不一定要生产力指标。

label.en: Return to a favourite I already know how to enjoy.
label.zh: 回到一个自己已知道怎样享受的老爱好。

label.en: Try a different format that makes the list feel playful again.
label.zh: 换一种新形式，让清单重新像在玩。

prompt.en: A casual online challenge comes with an enormous success story. What would you contribute?
prompt.zh: 轻松线上挑战配了一段特别宏大的成功故事，你更想贡献什么？

label.en: A down-to-earth observation that keeps the grand claim in proportion.
label.zh: 讲一句贴近现实的话，给宏大宣传降降调。

label.en: A familiar reference showing that simple enjoyment also lasts.
label.zh: 拿熟悉的例子说明，简单的快乐也能长久。

label.en: A trial of a new version of the challenge, with no promise attached.
label.zh: 不作效果承诺，试试挑战的新版本。

label.en: My ordinary repeatable entry without an ambitious headline.
label.zh: 按可重复的方式参加，不加雄心勃勃的标题。

prompt.en: You are choosing one item to bring to a low-key hobby swap. What appeals most?
prompt.zh: 参加轻松的兴趣物品交换，只带一件，你更喜欢什么？

label.en: Something familiar with a specific memory attached to it.
label.zh: 一件带着具体回忆的熟悉物品。

label.en: An example of a new format I have enjoyed exploring.
label.zh: 一个自己最近玩得开心的新形式样品。

label.en: A simple everyday item that fits the agreed exchange routine.
label.zh: 一件符合约定交换流程的简单日用品。

label.en: Something that captures an ordinary experience others may recognise.
label.zh: 一件能带出普通生活共鸣的东西。

prompt.en: A community offers a completely different way to present a familiar topic. What attracts you?
prompt.zh: 社区给熟悉话题换了一套完全不同的呈现方式，你被什么吸引？

label.en: Discovering how the new format changes what people can make.
label.zh: 看看新格式会让人做出什么不同东西。

label.en: Finding the stable steps that make participation straightforward.
label.zh: 找到让参加变简单的固定步骤。

label.en: The chance to share a recognisable feeling in my own words.
label.zh: 有机会用自己的话讲一种能引起共鸣的感受。

label.en: A manageable new possibility I can try without a big commitment.
label.zh: 有个不用大承诺、能小小试一下的新可能。

prompt.en: How would you prefer to end a quiet evening of online hobby browsing?
prompt.zh: 安静地刷完一晚兴趣内容，你更愿意怎样收尾？

label.en: Complete the little closing routine that makes the evening feel settled.
label.zh: 做完让这一晚有个收尾的小流程。

label.en: Send one message about a moment that felt familiar.
label.zh: 发一句话，说说某个熟悉的感受。

label.en: Save one small idea I might enjoy trying another day.
label.zh: 存下一点改天也许会喜欢尝试的小想法。

label.en: Leave a dry note about the absurdity of endlessly chasing the next big thing.
label.zh: 冷调地写一句，一直追下一个大东西有点荒诞。
